parts: I have a shiny application that I deployed as a web page. It works fine locally to load the data files. I use options(shiny.maxRequestSize=-1) to put no limit for the data upload. When i try to upload the data on web page it gies an error : 413 Request Entity Too. How to solve this poblem.
